ja259:1.1: Na-y-imassa vijjāmayam atthi kiñci na bandhavo no pana te sahāyo, atha kena vaṇṇena Tirīṭavaccho tedaṇḍiko bhuñjati aggapiṇḍan ti.
ja259:2.1: Āpāsu me yuddhaparājitassa ekassa katvā vivanasmi ghore pasārayi kicchagatassa pāṇim, ten' ūdatāriṃ dukhasampareto.
ja259:3.1: Etassa kiccena idhānupatto Vesāyino visayā jīvaloke, lābhāraho tāta Tirīṭavaccho, deth' assa bhogaṃ yajatañ ca yaññan ti.
